arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'config' AS kind,json_object('service',service,'value',value) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'pricing',json_object('flight_id',f.flight_id,'price',f.price_cents,'version',f.version,'cache',c.value) FROM flights f LEFT JOIN cache c ON c.key='quote:'||f.flight_id

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancels',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
